stories.title: Israeli FlyDubai passenger thanks Saudi Arabia after emergency landing

en.title: Israeli FlyDubai passenger thanks Saudi Arabia after emergency landing
en.summary: A passenger from a FlyDubai flight that made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after a pilot incident expressed gratitude to the Kingdom. The aircraft was carrying 174 people, including 166 Israelis, from the UAE to Israel.

en.title: Shura Council Chief: We Draw Inspiration from the Vision in All Meanings of Achievement and Initiative
en.summary: The head of Saudi Arabia's Shura Council stated that the council has received leadership support since its establishment and now draws inspiration from Vision 2030 after a decade of implementation. During the second year of its ninth session, the council held 46 sessions and issued 555 decisions.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia projects 2027 budget deficit at 3.6% of GDP

en.title: Saudi Arabia projects 2027 budget deficit at 3.6% of GDP
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Finance announced the 2027 budget with projected expenditures of 1.392 trillion riyals and revenues of 1.202 trillion riyals, resulting in a deficit of 3.6 percent of GDP. The fiscal plan aims to support economic growth while maintaining sustainability.
